theme.rationale: A sleek, deep obsidian dark mode is chosen for the Command Center to reduce glare for fleet operators monitoring screens all day, echoing modern EV tech interfaces like Tesla.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look) mixed with Glassmorphism for overlays. Flat dark surfaces with crisp 1px borders to organize dense information.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows on base cards; deeper drop-shadows (shadow-xl) for active modals or dragged kanban items.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-full for status chips and avatars, rounded-2xl for modals.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on the main dashboard background to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle and fast (150-300ms). Use ease-out for entrances. Strict compliance with prefers-reduced-motion.

layouts.desktop: Left-aligned sidebar navigation (w-64) with a top header for global search and notifications. Main content area uses a high-density 12-column grid layout with gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.mobile: Bottom navigation bar (Dashboard | Fleet | Rentals | More) with a floating Quick Action button (FAB) in the bottom-right corner.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grid for KPI cards (col-span-1 to col-span-3), large Map/Fleet Donut (col-span-full md:col-span-8), Recent Operations Timeline (col-span-4).

components.kpi_cards: Flat background, 1px border-zinc-800. Include animated counter numbers and a small graphical sparkline or trending arrow.
components.status_chips: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) with contextual status colors (bg + text color).
components.kanban_board: Horizontal scrolling columns (gap-4) for Service Requests. Draggable cards with avatar, vehicle ID, and status badge.
components.forms_wizards: Multi-step flows for Rentals. Use horizontal progress bars, clear segmented controls, and Shadcn inputs.
components.vehicle_cards: Display image or icon, Name, ID, battery progress bar (gradient fill based on %), and status chip.
components.tables: Modern, border-collapse tables with sticky headers. Use avatar + name lockups for drivers.

libraries.charts: recharts (for Donut charts, Bar charts, KPI sparklines)
libraries.maps: react-map-gl (Mapbox wrapper for dark-mode 3D city maps)
libraries.animations: framer-motion (for page transitions, drawer slides, drag/drop kanban)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI feels like a premium SaaS product, not an old ERP. Use generous padding (p-4 to p-6 inside cards).
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for all navigation and action items.
Implement a dark theme using Tailwind's zinc color palette (bg-zinc-950, surface bg-zinc-900).
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='create-rental-btn').
Use Recharts for the Fleet status Donut chart and Location capacity bars.
For the Kanban board, build a responsive grid. The user requested drag/drop, use framer-motion or a simple drag-and-drop HTML5 implementation if a heavy library isn't available.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Align content to the left to maintain readability in dense data screens.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays or sticky headers; use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent color (e.g., bg-zinc-900/80).
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn components for Select, Dialog, Dropdowns, DatePicker, etc.
Map out the correct routing for the Sidebar navigation: Dashboard, Fleet, Drivers, Rentals, Service Requests, Vehicle Service, Locations, Documents, Incidents, Vehicle Health, Reports, Settings.
For the mobile bottom nav, ensure it is fixed to the bottom (fixed bottom-0 w-full) with the FAB floating just above it.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
